about: Always-on overrides: applied by the game in every language (plain LINKDATA_PATCH
entries), unlike text/es-419/*.po, which only applies while es-419 is selected.
Keys are <record>:<row>[:<col>]; text uses the .po notation; ints replaces every
Row 80 of records 2323-2331 (ja en fr it de es zh-Hant ko zh-Hans) is the
confirmation prompt of the es-419 button on the language grid (rows 74-79 are
the prompts of the other languages; the patched main maps es-419 to row 80).
ints [1] marks the row as present, like rows 74-79.
